title: Towers embed into levelwise injective split towers
statement: For every inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system] A=(A_n,f_n)_{n\geq1} of abelian groups [def-sp-abelian], there is a monomorphism A\to I in the abelian category of towers [lem-pc-tower-abelian] such that every I_n is an injective abelian group [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and every transition map I_{n+1}\to I_n is a split surjection.

proof.text: For each n apply [lem-weil-pbc-ring-modules-enough-injectives] with R=\mathbb Z to the abelian group A_n, obtaining an injective abelian group J_n and a monomorphism j_n:A_n\to J_n.

Construct I_n and monomorphisms i_n:A_n\to I_n recursively. Set I_1=J_1 and i_1=j_1. Having I_n and i_n, set I_{n+1}=I_n\oplus J_{n+1}, put p_n:I_{n+1}\to I_n equal to the first projection, and define i_{n+1}(a)=(i_n(f_n(a)),j_{n+1}(a)). A finite direct sum of injective abelian groups is injective because a map into it extends componentwise, so every I_n is injective; p_n is split by the first summand inclusion. The defining formula gives p_n i_{n+1}=i_n f_n, so the i_n form a morphism of towers.

Each i_n is injective by its two coordinates: if i_{n+1}(a)=0 then j_{n+1}(a)=0, hence a=0, and i_1=j_1 is injective. A morphism of towers whose level maps are all injective is a monomorphism of towers: if g,h:T\to A are morphisms of towers with i\circ g=i\circ h, then i_n\circ g_n=i_n\circ h_n for every n because composition of morphisms of inverse systems is componentwise [def-weil-inverse-system], so g_n=h_n by injectivity of i_n, i.e. g=h. Thus A\to I is a monomorphism in the abelian category of towers [lem-pc-tower-abelian], while every p_n is a split surjection, proving the claim.

lean.statement: theorem tower_injective_embedding (A : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) : ∃ (I : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (i : A ⟶ I), Mono i ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, Injective (I.obj (Opposite.op n))) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, IsSplitEpi (I.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).op))
